description:
A network of trackset cross country ski trails leading directly from the townsite of Wells. The network has a variety of loops providing the ability to customize your outing.

NOTE: Effective July 23, 2025 the "Huckleberry Trail" from Wells to Cornish Mountain via the Moose Island Bridge will be CLOSED. Access to the mountain and trails will be via the Forest Education Boardwalk.

NON MOTORIZED TRAIL - YEAR ROUND
directions:
From Quesnel travel East on Hwy 26 to Wells. Park anywhere in town and you can quickly tie into the trail system.

Be advised there is a network of snowmobile trails as well, so be aware of the signage.
title: Cornish Cross-Country Ski Trails
